questions.question: A prophet compared the nations to something small next to God. What did he say the nations are like?

answers.text: Like a drop in a bucket

questions.question: In a prophet's message about how great God is, where is God said to sit enthroned?

answers.text: Above the circle of the earth

questions.question: When a prophet told people to look up at the stars, what did he say God does for each star?

answers.text: He calls each one by name
He gives each one a season
He hides each one by day

questions.question: Even young people grow tired and weary. According to a prophet, who will renew their strength?

answers.text: Those who wait upon the LORD
Those who bring gifts to the LORD
Those who fast before the LORD
